summary: Kimi Antonelli's Ferrari homecoming collides with championship ambition as Italy grapples with whether to back the homegrown rookie's title dream or rally solely behind the Scuderia. Pierre Gasly's stunning Alpine pole upset the Mercedes and Ferrari hierarchy, setting up a qualifying masterclass that could reshape Sunday's strategy across the grid. A victory here would inject critical momentum into the title fight while cementing whether this weekend belongs to Antonelli's breakthrough narrative or Ferrari's resurgence with their upgraded engine.
